svg.text: Work up every one, in order

svg.text: 1 · Vitals (is she STABLE?), history, general + abdominal + pelvic exam · SPECULUM, always: mass through the os, ulcerated

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: cervix · a negative Pap test does not end it

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · Transvaginal ultrasound: endometrium < 5 mm is normal (on HRT too: > 5 mm in over half, < 4% of those have pathology →

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: investigate if bleeding persists) · > 5 mm → saline infusion sonohysterogram: finds focal lesions (93–100%) but CANNOT tell

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: are in that group) · 99.6% sensitive, but blind: misses polyps · HYSTEROSCOPY for focal lesions or a failed office biopsy · D&C
